scope: Consistent staff workout reporting, precise recorded durations, distinct current-plan progress and scoped refresh recovery

dataContract.completed: Saved personal, assigned and extra completions ended in the selected reporting dates/timezone, using existing qualification and linked-log selection
dataContract.currentPlan: Assigned-plan progress over the current fourteen days; separate from all completions
dataContract.duration: Valid active timer (including zero), else labeled elapsed estimate; minutes shown up to one decimal
dataContract.history: Both saved log collections remain staff-readable independently of creation controls
dataContract.consistency: Selected admin Workouts panel validates saved completion and duration totals against the asynchronous report projection; mismatches stay updating or explicitly stale, with at most five attempts per read sequence
dataContract.refresh: One shared admin player Refresh activity; visible player workout checks at most once per minute, report return/manual refresh only
dataContract.retention: Only successful same-account/scope data retained on recognized transients; denials and incompatible or changed scopes clear retained data

Coach comparison denies the other owned team player
